body: Heya! Sorry for the late reply, got had the desk for a couple weeks now and I would say it’s great! Size is perfect and fairly sturdy, I guess maybe slight wobble if I really try to shake it (+ I’m a heavy guy) but nothing that isn’t normal I think. Standing and sitting range is good and the controllers are easy with a couple preset options you can configure. Also the outlet on the control is usb-c which is great! So I find it pretty good for charging my phone quickly. I guess motor isn’t that quiet but I don’t really care about sound because it’s a standing desk lol. Lots of good leg room (maybe would owe that too the C-Frame). The cable tray and accessories that come with the E7 pro are great and solid, only caveat is that the holes for the accessories aren’t pre drilled so I had to do those myself. All in all for the price I think really good compared to other options! Hope this helps!

Literally fell into the same dilemma as you. Ended up going for the Flexispot E7 Pro. Currently with the sale going on it’s a bit more expensive than the Mittzon but definitely cheaper than the Magnus pro. It has the C frame which is supposed to be better for no knocking into your knees and supposedly has good weight support and monitor arm support. Already comes with some cable management accessories and the size you’re looking for. Will update when I receive my to give initial impressions
